experimentDefinitions.title: Can anything beat the market's own price? (walk-forward calibration study)
experimentDefinitions.hypothesis: Leakage-safe book/momentum features at fixed decision horizons (T-120/90/60/30/10s) can beat the market mid-price out of sample.
experimentDefinitions.nullHypothesis: I can't beat the market's own price: OOS AUC(model) <= AUC(mid) at every horizon.
experimentDefinitions.successCriteria: Positive OOS AUC delta vs mid at any horizon, walk-forward by UTC day with >=7 train days.

experimentDefinitions.title: R1: cross-feed basis, gate false-fire, and lag reconciliation (local collector)
experimentDefinitions.hypothesis: An absolute cross-feed gate at 0.10% fires structurally on raw BTC basis, and rolling structural-basis correction reduces the false-fire share by at least half.
experimentDefinitions.nullHypothesis: Structural correction does not materially reduce absolute-gate false fires (basis is already centered).
experimentDefinitions.successCriteria: SUPPORTED when corrected false-fire share <= 0.5x raw share at the 0.10% gate; REFUTED when corrected >= raw; else INCONCLUSIVE. DATA_GATED when the collector export is absent.

experimentDefinitions.title: R7: gist_composite_v1 ablation + calibration on collector snapshots
experimentDefinitions.hypothesis: score_strength = min(|score|/7, 1) is not a probability: treated as one it scores materially worse (Brier) than the book mid on the same rows, and the window delta dominates every ablation.
experimentDefinitions.nullHypothesis: score_strength calibrates as well as the book mid (Brier difference <= 0), i.e. it could legitimately be displayed as a probability.
experimentDefinitions.successCriteria: SUPPORTED when Brier(score_strength-as-probability) - Brier(book mid) > 0 for the exact_gist_weights variant at T-10; REFUTED when <= 0; INCONCLUSIVE when n < 30; DATA_GATED when the collector export is absent.

experimentDefinitions.title: R2: momentum & sustained-run continuation on BTC (kachoio outcomes + collector deltas)
experimentDefinitions.hypothesis: The source's ETH pattern reproduces on BTC market outcomes: continuation is below 50% and declines monotonically with run length (mean reversion grows with run persistence).
experimentDefinitions.nullHypothesis: Continuation is independent of run length (flat at ~50%).
experimentDefinitions.successCriteria: SUPPORTED when continuation for run>=2..run>=5 is strictly decreasing AND every rate < 0.5; REFUTED when any rate >= 0.5 or the ordering increases; else INCONCLUSIVE.

experimentDefinitions.title: R8: extended-move fade — yearly reversal reproduction + executable-price reality (kachoio)
experimentDefinitions.hypothesis: After >=4 consecutive same-direction 5-minute windows, the next window reverses more often than 50% on 2026 data (the source's phenomenon), BUT the executable fade price and maker adverse selection erase the claimed ~4pp paper edge.
experimentDefinitions.nullHypothesis: Reversal after a 20-minute run is <= 50% (no fade phenomenon).
experimentDefinitions.successCriteria: Phenomenon SUPPORTED when the 2026 reversal rate's Wilson CI lower bound > 0.5; REFUTED when the CI upper bound < 0.5; else INCONCLUSIVE. Economics reported separately: the fade stays non-promotable unless conservative net EV after costs is positive (it is not expected to be).

experimentDefinitions.title: R5: entry-time net-EV surface T-180..T-5 with fees and displayed-touch fills (kachoio)
experimentDefinitions.hypothesis: Net EV at the displayed ask varies systematically with decision time and turns apparently positive late in the window — consistent with the late-favorite-drift artifact (stale quotes, ~$100 displayed size), not with a harvestable retail edge.
experimentDefinitions.nullHypothesis: The entry-time surface is flat: no decision time shows CI-positive net EV at the touch.
experimentDefinitions.successCriteria: SUPPORTED when >=1 grid point has net-EV CI lower bound > 0 at the displayed touch AND the positive region grows toward expiry (drift shape); REFUTED when all grid points are CI-negative; else INCONCLUSIVE. A SUPPORTED result is explicitly NOT a trade recommendation (fill model is optimistic).

experimentDefinitions.title: R11: higher-band taker microstructure research slot (preregistered analogue)
experimentDefinitions.hypothesis: Under OUR preregistered definitions (favored ask in [0.80,0.97) at T-30s, favored mid rising over the prior 30s, taker at the displayed ask, current 0.07 fee), per-trade ROI at the displayed touch is positive — an analogue, NOT a verification, of the commenter's ~3% ROI.
experimentDefinitions.nullHypothesis: Analogue per-trade ROI <= 0 at the displayed touch.
experimentDefinitions.successCriteria: SUPPORTED when the primary ROI's 95% CI lower bound > 0 at the displayed touch; REFUTED when the CI upper bound < 0; else INCONCLUSIVE. Any SUPPORTED verdict carries the latency-pool attribution and the 1-tick-slippage variant, and authorizes nothing.

experimentDefinitions.title: R4: trend-side price bands within a causal 30-minute trend (kachoio)
experimentDefinitions.hypothesis: Cheap trend-side tokens win at roughly their price, not above it: apparent cheapness is not a discount once the trend is defined causally and the price paid is the displayed ask.
experimentDefinitions.nullHypothesis: Trend-side tokens below 0.45 win more often than their ask price plus fee (a real discount).
experimentDefinitions.successCriteria: SUPPORTED when the 0.00-0.45 band's win rate is <= its mean ask + 2pp (no discount); REFUTED when its Wilson CI lower bound exceeds mean ask + fee-adjusted margin; else INCONCLUSIVE.

experimentDefinitions.title: R3: favored-side price-band calibration by executable ask (kachoio) + 127-gap accounting
experimentDefinitions.hypothesis: Hold-to-resolution favored-side buys at the displayed ask underperform the fee-adjusted break-even (source fee 0.072) across price bands, and the source's 127-decision count gap is explainable by an extreme-price exclusion class at some plausible decision time.
experimentDefinitions.nullHypothesis: Band win rates meet or exceed the fee-adjusted break-even (the market undercharges favorites).
experimentDefinitions.successCriteria: SUPPORTED when >=4 of 6 bands show win rate below the 0.072-fee break-even at the T-270s primary decision time (source showed 6/6); REFUTED when <=2; else INCONCLUSIVE.

experimentDefinitions.title: R6: exit-policy grid + winner/loser pullback and recovery (kachoio)
experimentDefinitions.hypothesis: No tested exit rule (fixed stops, trailing stops, break-even arming, take-profit ladders, threshold-cross, time exit) improves mean PnL over hold-to-resolution on the same favored-side entries: stops convert normal winner volatility into realized losses.
experimentDefinitions.nullHypothesis: At least one exit rule beats hold-to-resolution mean PnL per cost.
experimentDefinitions.successCriteria: SUPPORTED when every tested policy's mean PnL/cost is below hold-to-resolution's; REFUTED when any policy's CI lower bound exceeds hold's mean; else INCONCLUSIVE.
